1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 c5 3.Nf3 d5 4.cxd5 Nxd5 5.strategy: Completes the kingside fianchetto and prepares to castle. White's own knight on f3 still stands in the bishop's way, so for the moment only the c3-knight presses on d5, and White is content to wait.

The retreat that defines this set-up: the knight leaves d5 before a trade could pull the queen onto the long diagonal. From c7 it still guards d5 and makes room for a solid wall of pawns on c5 and e5 that holds down d4. The price is time.
1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 c5 3.Nf3 d5 4.cxd5 Nxd5 5.name: English Opening: Symmetrical Variation, Rubinstein Variation
